title: A2A Authentication Module
summary: This module provides a comprehensive set of client-side and server-side authentication schemes for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, including API keys, bearer tokens, HTTP Basic/Digest, and OAuth2 flows, along with utilities for handling authentication retries.

nodes.label: A2A Client
nodes.title: A2A Client
nodes.description: Represents an agent or service initiating requests to another agent or service.

nodes.label: HTTP Client
nodes.title: HTTP Client (httpx)
nodes.description: The underlying asynchronous HTTP client library (e.g., httpx) used for sending requests.

nodes.label: API Key Client Auth
nodes.title: APIKeyAuth
nodes.description: Applies API key authentication to outgoing requests, supporting header, query, or cookie locations.

nodes.label: Bearer Token Client Auth
nodes.title: BearerTokenAuth
nodes.description: Adds a Bearer token to the Authorization header for client authentication.

nodes.label: HTTP Basic Client Auth
nodes.title: HTTPBasicAuth
nodes.description: Encodes and adds HTTP Basic authentication credentials to the Authorization header.

nodes.label: HTTP Digest Client Auth
nodes.title: HTTPDigestAuth
nodes.description: Configures the HTTP client to handle HTTP Digest authentication challenges and responses.

nodes.label: OAuth2 Client Credentials
nodes.title: OAuth2ClientCredentials
nodes.description: Manages the OAuth2 client credentials flow to obtain and automatically refresh access tokens.

nodes.label: OAuth2 Authorization Code
nodes.title: OAuth2AuthorizationCode
nodes.description: Handles the OAuth2 authorization code flow, including interactive authorization and token refreshing.

nodes.label: Retry on 401 Utility
nodes.title: retry_on_401
nodes.description: A utility function that retries HTTP requests upon receiving a 401 Unauthorized status, attempting to refresh authentication credentials.

nodes.label: A2A Server
nodes.title: A2A Server
nodes.description: Represents an agent or service receiving and authenticating incoming requests.

nodes.label: Simple Token Server Auth
nodes.title: SimpleTokenAuth
nodes.description: Validates incoming requests against a pre-configured static bearer token or environment variable.

nodes.label: OIDC Server Auth
nodes.title: OIDCAuth
nodes.description: Validates JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) using OpenID Connect (OIDC) discovery and JSON Web Key Sets (JWKS).

nodes.label: OAuth2 Server Auth
nodes.title: OAuth2ServerAuth
nodes.description: Validates OAuth2 access tokens using either JWKS for JWTs or token introspection for opaque tokens.

nodes.label: API Key Server Auth
nodes.title: APIKeyServerAuth
nodes.description: Validates API keys provided in headers, query parameters, or cookies on incoming requests.

nodes.label: mTLS Server Auth
nodes.title: MTLSServerAuth
nodes.description: A marker indicating that Mutual TLS authentication is required, with verification handled at the transport layer.

nodes.label: Enterprise Token Server Auth
nodes.title: EnterpriseTokenAuth
nodes.description: A placeholder for enterprise-specific token validation via a dedicated verification service.

nodes.label: External Auth Service
nodes.title: External Auth Service
nodes.description: An external service providing OAuth2 token endpoints, OIDC JWKS, or token introspection capabilities.

groups.label: Basic Client Auth Schemes
groups.title: Basic Client Authentication Schemes
groups.description: Classes for applying fundamental authentication methods like API keys, bearer tokens, and HTTP Basic/Digest to outgoing requests.

groups.label: OAuth Client Auth Schemes
groups.title: OAuth Client Authentication Schemes
groups.description: Classes for managing OAuth2 flows (Client Credentials and Authorization Code) to secure client requests.

groups.label: Basic Server Auth Schemes
groups.title: Basic Server Authentication Schemes
groups.description: Classes for validating incoming requests using simple tokens, API keys, mTLS, or enterprise-specific tokens.

groups.label: Advanced Server Auth Schemes
groups.title: Advanced Server Authentication Schemes
groups.description: Classes for robust token validation on the server side, including OIDC JWTs and OAuth2 tokens via JWKS or introspection.

groups.label: Authentication Utilities
groups.title: Authentication Utilities
groups.description: Helper functions for managing authentication flows, such as retrying failed requests.

groups.label: A2A Communication Actors
groups.title: A2A Communication Actors
groups.description: Representations of the client and server endpoints in an Agent-to-Agent communication.
